pages.title: Normal Nodes
pages.text: Normal nodes can be moved directly. A bead turns gold when its value equals its target. An unlinked normal node changes only itself and forms the simplest independent pathway.

pages.title: Linked Pathways
pages.text: Connected nodes move together. A positive golden path moves its neighbor in the same direction; a jade path marked with - moves its neighbor in the opposite direction. One bead may drive several paths.

pages.title: Locked Nodes
pages.text: Gray locked beads cannot be moved directly. Adjust connected beads to push them toward their targets through formation paths. Locked nodes begin appearing at total restriction layer 46.

pages.title: Unstable Nodes
pages.text: Red-jade pulsing beads are unstable. After the displayed movement interval, one shifts by itself and may drive linked nodes. Unstable nodes begin appearing at total restriction layer 55.

pages.title: Hidden Nodes
pages.text: A hidden node displays ? instead of its target. Infer the value from pathway behavior or spend a restriction hint. Hidden targets and limited moves begin at total restriction layer 73.
